description: Zumper is a rental marketplace for apartment and home listings, along with rental market trend data and neighborhood insights. Its site content focuses on rental search, market reports, and renter/property-management tools.
summary: Zumper exposes a public MCP server at `https://chatgpt.zumper.com/mcp`; no other developer-facing HTTP/GraphQL API or CLI surface was found on `zumper.com`.
